_comment: REAL Dedaub warning rows read 2026-07-14 from ethereum.vulnerability_denorm via the dedaub-monitoring MCP server (SELECT to_jsonb(row)). SANITIZED: the two `address` values are replaced with placeholders; every other field (keys, enum labels, bytea `\x` hex format, integer `stmt`, timestamps, descriptions) is verbatim as delivered. This is the authoritative shape adapters/dedaub.py is validated against.

rows.vulnerability_type: ERC20 call demands high-level return value
rows.description: ERC20 call does not accept implementations (as in USDT) that do not have a high-level return value
rows.debug_message: Call to `transfer(address,uint256)` will fail if performed on a token on which the operation does not return a value. This is particularly an issue for USDT and other old tokens that have no high-level return value in their token operations.

rows.description: Storage location never written, only read. Should have been declared immutable to enable inlining.
rows.debug_message: Storage location `stor0xb` is only read. Possible error or should be declared immutable for gas savings.
